messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up — BigBank wants an air-gapped POC. No external egress, keys must be KMS/HSM-backed, and legal flagged tool-calls as a blocker. pricing + timeline pls
aj-ml: thanks. do they want streaming + function/tool calling in the POC or just batch outputs?
maria-sales: they explicitly asked for streaming chat with tool calls (invoke internal ledger service) and structured JSON outputs for reconciliation.
chris-sre: big blocker: air-gapped means we can't use hosted Redwood API. we'll need a Private deployment (VPC/on-prem). KMS integration + HSM keywrap required.
nora-legal: confirm: keys must be customer-managed, HSM-backed, and audit logs retained for 7 years. also need proof of no outbound traffic from the inference nodes.
ben-devex: for SDKs: we can run our Rust/Go SDKs in offline mode pointing at local private runtime. function-calls are supported but the runtime needs a local connector to the bank's internal services (no internet webhooks).
liz-eng: technical note: streaming + tool calls increase session state (KV cache + active connections). estimate additional CPU/GPU memory ~10-15% and need reserved capacity to meet latency SLOs under load.
aj-ml: POC approach suggestion: deploy Private with dedicated pool + an on-prem connector shim that handles tool-call RPCs to internal services. shim runs in customer's subnet and signs requests with customer KMS. no outbound internet required.
maria-sales: timeline and cost? customer asked for a rough figure to unblock procurement.
chris-sre: rough: Private deployment setup + KMS/HSM integration + on-prem connector = 6-8 engineer-weeks (infra/eng/sre). Dedicated reserved capacity 3x baseline for POC: $Xk/month (ballpark). I'll get a more specific sizing if you share expected QPS and avg tokens.
nora-legal: need a diagram and list of all network flows and logs stored. also a sample KMS integration plan (key rotation, access controls).
ben-devex: I'll draft the SDK usage notes and a small example for offline tool hooks. snippet below (pseudo):
```
// local shim config
redwood_sdk.connect({ endpoint: "https://local-runtime:8443", auth: { type: "kms", key_id: "arn:aws:kms:..." } });
// call with streaming and tool handler
chat.stream({ model: "redwood-xxl" }, {
  onToolCall: (tool) => invokeLocalService(tool)
});
```

liz-eng: also include a config for structured output enforcement (JSON schema validation) to avoid downstream reconciliation mismatches. we can add a server-side schema check in the runtime.
aj-ml: security note: for function/tool calling we should sign and mutually auth connections between runtime and shim. mTLS + customer KMS for signing.
maria-sales: good. can we get a short one-pager for procurement: scope, rough cost, timeline, requirements?
chris-sre: yes — i'll prepare network/data-flow + ops requirements. need their expected QPS, concurrent users, avg prompt length.
nora-legal: i'll prepare the legal answers; can someone confirm where logs reside and who has access (redwood ops vs customer)?
ben-devex: logs: by default in Private they stay in customer's storage. we can optionally send to Redwood for support with explicit agreement. will note in the one-pager.
maria-sales: thanks team. action items: chris — sizing & network diagram by EOD tomorrow; ben — SDK offline example + schema sample; aj — deployment checklist and estimated eng-weeks; nora — legal answers draft. i'll loop in the AE and procurement contact once we have the one-pager. :thumbsup:
liz-eng: ping if you want me to join the customer call, can help with performance Qs.
aj-ml: one more FYI — quantization/low-precision models help cap GPU mem but may affect answer fidelity for tool-call parsing. tradeoff to document.
maria-sales: noted. closing thread for now, will reopen after diagrams.
